Messages.Author: Frogbear
Messages.Body:
Lorenzo Detuono
Aus / Dem / DOM / NEC / POT
Independent. Red List : If Lorenzo is ready at the end of combat and the
opposing minion is not, Lorenzo may burn 5 blood to move the opposing
minion to your ready region (with 1 life for an ally with no life) instead.

Illusions of the Kindred
Type: Combat
Requires: Chimerstry
Cost: 2 blood
Only usable before range is determined.
[chi] Combat ends. Move the bottom card of your crypt to your ready
region. He or she does not contest any other vampires or titles in play.
The vampire has an amount of blood equal to half of his or her capacity
(round down). Combat begins between the vampire and the opposing minion.
Remove the crypt card from the game at the end of combat.
[CHI] As above, but the vampire has an amount of blood equal to his or
her capacity.

Ravnos gets into combat, playing Illusions at superior to pull Lorenzo
from the crypt. Thoughts betrayed, bins, steals and then dissapears.
Trouble is getting the Ravnos out in the opening 4 while keeping a crypt
full of Lorenzo

Maybe not too competative but may be a fun idea for someone to make as a
deck.

Who knows....

Andrew
*beside myself with grief*

Yes -- if the illusion removes him from play. Specials on cards not in play
cannot be used. (Plus, he wouldn't meet the "if ready" condition if he were
removed from play.)

Anyway, they have the same window, so the acting Methuselah orders the effects,
as usual.
